Product Details: 3M Combo Liquid Wax (200 ml) and Ultimate Polish (473 ml) - Distributed/Packaged by 3M. Product Details: PLW- Premium Liquid Wax is a clear coat safe wax. Use on all cured paint finishes. For use by hand or with an orbital polisher. Special formulation is capable of removing road film or light oxidation from car finishes. Heavily oxidized finishes may require compounding with 3M (TM) super duty rubbing compound, part number 39004 prior to applying wax. Ultimate polish also adds depth of color, especially on dark-colored cars and leaves the paint finish incredibly clear, glossy with mirror-like reflections. Eliminates fine swirls, perfecting the paint prior to waxing. Safe on all glossy paints including clear coats.
